key_themes: AI chip sector bifurcation: Marvell beats while Zscaler disappoints on guidance
Oil prices drop as Iran signals partial Strait of Hormuz reopening, lifting airlines
Earnings wave: Snowflake skyrockets on $6B AWS deal; Verra Mobility crashes on Avis contract loss

stocks.reason: Soared ~32% after-hours on Q1 FY2027 earnings beat (revenue +33% YoY to $1.39B) and announcement of $6B multiyear deal with AWS for Graviton CPU access; raised full-year sales outlook
Crashed ~46% after Avis Budget Group terminated its contract effective September 2026, wiping ~$135-145M in annual revenue; company slashed full-year 2026 guidance to $985M-$995M from $1.02B-$1.03B

Plunged ~23% despite Q3 earnings beat (EPS $1.08 vs $1.01 est); Q4 revenue guidance of $875-878M missed $879M consensus; company cited two key sales leader departures and accelerated equipment spending
Rose ~6% to record high after Q1 FY2027 revenue of $2.42B (+28% YoY) beat estimates; guided Q2 to $2.7B (+35% YoY); ~74% of revenue from data center AI custom chips including AWS Trainium partnership
Jumped ~15% after Q1 2026 results exceeded guidance; Q2 EPS outlook of $0.20-$0.25 met expectations; CFO Eva Boratto announced departure effective June 12
Continued AI memory momentum after crossing $1 trillion market cap on May 26 (+19%); UBS tripled price target to $1,625; Barclays raised PT 74% to $1,175; stock trading ~$915 with $1.03T market cap

Surged ~10% after simultaneous upgrades from JPMorgan (Neutral→Overweight, PT $41→$46) and Truist (Hold→Buy, PT $42→$55); both cited resilient U.S. leisure travel demand and Las Vegas Strip EBITDA recovery

Rose ~7.5% after Barclays upgraded to Overweight from Equal Weight and set $2,300 PT (from $1,200); analyst cited $42B+ in contractual revenue guarantees through 2031 and memory/storage as "most attractive vertical"; stock up ~4,000% over past year

Climbed ~3.4% after JPMorgan upgraded to Overweight from Neutral and raised PT to $460 from $432; analyst cited upcoming freight business spinoff on June 1 as value-unlocking catalyst and visible progress on Network 2.0 restructuring

Rose ~6.3% as oil prices fell below $90/barrel after Iran signaled restoration of Strait of Hormuz commercial traffic; UBS raised PT to $148 (Buy); company projects 53M+ summer passengers, ~3M more than last year
Downgraded to Hold from Buy at Deutsche Bank with $110 PT; analyst cited continued weakness in core low-income consumer spending and competitive pressure from discount peers
Downgraded to Neutral from Buy at Bank of America with $140 PT; BofA cited valuation concerns and slowing enterprise software spending environment
